name: cyclin B3
pathways: G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle

function.text: CCNB3 encodes G2/mitotic-specific cyclin-B3. Annotated molecular activities include cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. It participates in G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.
